Today, two dogs went to play in the hay. There was milk on a tray. The farmer said, “Stay away from the tray!” But the dogs hit the tray and made the milk spray. The farmer began to say, “You will pay!” But the dogs ran away. Hoy, dos perros fueron a jugar en el heno. Había leche en una bandeja. El granjero dijo: “¡Aléjense de la bandeja!”.
